description: Joule Agent Integration - Create the lib/joule module with machine extractor for @agent-annotated CDS services, pre-built ReAct loop patterns, and runtime validation adapter. This enables MBT for Joule/CAP agents.
steps: 1. Create lib/joule/index.js - Module entry point that re-exports machine-extractor, react-templates, and runtime-adapter.

2. Create lib/joule/machine-extractor.js - Implement extractMachine(cdsFilePath) function that parses CDS files for @agent annotation. Extract service actions as transitions, map @agent.hitl to approval states. Return XState machine definition. Support both annotation-based and programmatic extraction via extractFromDefinition(serviceDefinition).

3. Create lib/joule/react-templates.js - Implement createReActMachine(config) for standard ReAct loop (observe -> think -> act -> observe cycle). Implement createA2AMachine(config) for A2A protocol states (initialize -> negotiate -> execute -> finalize). Implement createHITLMachine(config) for human-in-the-loop patterns (request -> pending_approval -> approved/rejected). Implement createSubagentMachine(config) for subagent coordination (spawn -> monitor -> collect -> synthesize). All use xstate createMachine with proper context, guards, actions.

4. Create lib/joule/runtime-adapter.js - Implement RuntimeAdapter class that connects to a running agent for live validation. Methods: attach(agentInstance), detach(), onStateChange(callback), validateCurrent(invariants). Use event emitter pattern for state change notifications.
acceptance_criteria: lib/joule/index.js exports extractMachine, createReActMachine, createA2AMachine, createHITLMachine, createSubagentMachine, RuntimeAdapter
extractMachine() returns a valid XState machine definition from mock CDS content
All four create*Machine() functions return valid XState machines
RuntimeAdapter has attach(), detach(), onStateChange(), validateCurrent() methods
lib/index.js successfully requires and re-exports the joule module
verification: Run: node -e "const j = require('./lib/joule'); console.log(Object.keys(j))" - should list all exports
Run: node -e "const {createReActMachine} = require('./lib/joule'); const m = createReActMachine({id:'test'}); console.log(m.id)" - should print 'test'
findings: Successfully created lib/joule module with 4 files: index.js (module entry point), machine-extractor.js (extractMachine, extractFromDefinition, parseAnnotations, buildStates), react-templates.js (createReActMachine, createA2AMachine, createHITLMachine, createSubagentMachine), and runtime-adapter.js (RuntimeAdapter class with attach, detach, onStateChange, validateCurrent methods). All functions return valid XState machines and follow existing code patterns with JSDoc comments. Verified: (1) lib/joule exports 9 items including all required exports, (2) createReActMachine returns machine with correct id, (3) lib/index.js re-exports joule module correctly, (4) npm test passes with no issues.
